description: Cross-engine parity for the playback frame-cache SAMPLE-AND-HOLD lookup. The native cache (src-tauri/src/monitor/frame_cache.rs `VideoFrameCache::frame_le_with_max_lag`) and the web cache (src/utils/video-editor/compositor/VideoFrameCache.ts `VideoFrameCache.frameLe`) both return the cached frame with the GREATEST PTS <= target, unless it lags the target by more than max_lag (then it is a miss so the caller decodes the true frame). Both key frames on a MILLISECOND grid (round(pts*1000)) so adjacent frames on a VFR source never collapse to one bucket the way a round(pts*avg_fps) key would. Cases are expressed in integer milliseconds and are fed to `frame_le_with_max_lag` (native) / `frameLe` (web) verbatim after converting ms->seconds. `framePtsMs` is the set of cached frame PTS; `expectedPtsMs` is the served frame's PTS, or null for a miss.

cases.name: cfr floor: held frame is the greatest pts <= target
before the first frame is a miss
exact hit on a frame boundary
vfr frames 10ms apart do NOT collapse (sub-avg-interval)
vfr: the later of two close frames is served past it
hold within the lag guard is served
stale beyond the lag guard is a miss
sparse cache: floor across a large gap still holds within lag
